new_libraries.name: CZ-N706B-Arduino
new_libraries.author: CodeZoo
new_libraries.sentence: AT command support and examples for the CodeZoo CZ-N706B modem on UNO R4, ESP32 and ESP32-S3.
new_libraries.paragraph: Shared UART and power control with 21 examples for module checks, network setup and monitoring, files, certificates, TCP/UDP, TLS, Gmail SMTP, HTTP/HTTPS, downloads, MQTT, AWS IoT and time synchronization. Supports UNO R4, ESP32 Dev Module and ESP32S3 Dev Module.
